course_position.stage_name: Solid B1+ to Low B2 Development

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Explain reasons and results with eftersom and därför in an appointment problem.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Rearranging a healthcare, repair, or service appointment when timing no longer works.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Giving a clear reason for a change and explaining the result.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about whether to move an appointment because the time conflicts with another obligation.

main_focus.name: reason and result with eftersom and därför
main_focus.description: Use eftersom to give the reason inside a subordinate clause and därför to introduce the result in a main clause with V2.
model_examples: Jag måste boka om tiden eftersom jag jobbar sent.
Tiden passar inte, därför ringer jag i morgon.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use eftersom 3-4 times and därför 2-3 times where the reason-result relationship is clear.

allowed_supporting_grammar: modal verbs for obligation and possibility
avoid_grammar: multiple connectors stacked in one sentence

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use the appointment words and reason-result chunks to keep the explanation concrete.

dialogue_shape.opening: A timing conflict with an appointment is introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They explain the reason for the conflict, discuss consequences, and compare two possible fixes.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose how to solve the appointment problem.

target_complexity.repetition: Recycle att from Day 1 only if it supports the reason-result explanation.

focus: the reason the appointment no longer works
the consequence of the timing conflict
which solution is chosen and why

sentence_focus: one sentence with eftersom explaining a conflict
one sentence with därför and correct V2 word order
one sentence asking which solution is easiest
one sentence combining a reason and a practical result
